about_the_game:
Everything’s changed...

You're drowning in debt, blackmail, and rising connections to the criminal underworld. Every choice you make shifts your relationships. How far are you willing to go to chase your perfect fantasy—and the life you think you deserve?

This season takes the story to new heights with deeper character arcs, more drama, and kinkier consequences. Whether you’re returning or jumping in fresh, expect tension, transformation, and a cast of gorgeous women caught in your orbit.

Features

• Three distinct paths—Harem, Pimp, or NTR—each with unique scenes and endings
• Gorgeous new 3D renders and vastly improved Blender-based animations
• Erotic drama, criminal intrigue, and impactful decisions
• Sue’s evolution continues: Will she reclaim her old self… or fall deeper into corruption?
• Visual Novel with, in-game phone, texts/social media, unlockable galleries, and much more!

content_descriptors.notes: The content includes nudity, depictions of alternative lifestyles, implied alcohol and drug use, graphic representations of various sexual acts including oral, vaginal, anal, and non-penetrative acts, as well as bodily fluids. All characters are fictional and 21+ and there is no rape in the game.
